standard_prerequisites.name: Etale sheaf property on X_etale: sections are determined by their restrictions to the members of an etale covering and glue uniquely from compatible data
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: invoked at proof lines 278-289 for both the open covering and the etale covering
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the two displayed bijections of sections with prescribed support.

core_obligations: Form Z'' = phi^{-1}(Z) and observe Z' is closed in Z'' while Z' -> Z'' is etale as a morphism of schemes etale over Z, hence open; conclude Z'' = Z' amalgame T with T closed (proof lines 273-277).

Read the first bijection off the open covering U' = (U'\T) cup (U'\Z') and the second off the etale covering {U'\T -> U, U\Z -> U}; restriction gives the canonical bijection and identifies the middle set when phi^{-1}(Z) = Z' (proof lines 278-290).
proof_roadmap: Decompose Z'' = phi^{-1}(Z) into the open piece Z' and the closed complement T (proof lines 273-277).
Derive both support-bijection displays from the sheaf property on the two coverings (proof lines 278-290).
